newsitem.title: FINLAND: Trading limits on Raisio eased - bourse.
newsitem.headline: Trading limits on Raisio eased - bourse.

text.p: Trading limits on shares in food group Raisio were eased on Tuesday as its stock soared after it said it had chosen a U.S. partner for the key ingredient in its Benecol margarine, a bourse official said.

"The range from the previous close is 15 percent, but if the price rises suddenly it has to be relaxed, and we now raised it to 25 percent which means that at 465 markka it would have to be removed again," said bourse manager Olli Kukkonen.
At 1605/1305 GMT, the share stood at 455.00 markka, up 85.00 markka or 23 percent, after hitting a 460.00 markka high.
"The 25 percent range seems to be enough," he said, adding that further easing would be considered in case of further gains: "A market place cannot be a hindrance to trade."
